step1_analysis.description: This circuit appears to be a bias generator and tuning control sub-circuit, likely part of a voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) or switched-capacitor bank. It features diode-connected PMOS and NMOS transistors to establish a reference voltage, along with several dummy transistors (gates tied to GND or drain/source shorted) for layout matching and parasitic capacitance balancing.

paper_reference.title: A Fully Integrated 0.13µm CMOS 10Gb Ethernet Transceiver with XAUI Interface

bias_voltage_n0.description: DC reference voltage established by the diode-connected PMOS and NMOS voltage divider at node N0.

sky130_expected.calculation: Equating currents of 2 parallel PMOS (XM1, XM9) and 2 parallel NMOS (XM3, XM5): 50uA/V^2 * (1.8 - V0 - 0.42)^2 = 270uA/V^2 * (V0 - 0.42)^2. Solving yields V0 ≈ 0.71V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The NMOS has higher mobility than the PMOS in SKY130, pulling the divider voltage below VDD/2.

power_consumption.description: Static power dissipation of the bias branch.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the saturation current of the diode-connected transistors. The paper's 898mW is for the entire 10GbE transceiver, not this isolated sub-block.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the DC bias voltage at N0 and the static power consumption of the sub-circuit. High-value dummy resistors are added to prevent floating node errors during simulation.
step3_testbench.spice:
* VCO Tuning / Bias Sub-circuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VGND GND 0 0
VVCTRL VCTRL 0 0.9
VCOARSE COARSE_CONTROL 0 0

* DUT
XM1 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N5 GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N3 COARSE_CONTROL N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N1 VCTRL N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N4 GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N1 VCTRL N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

* Dummy resistors to prevent floating nodes
R1 N1 GND 1G
R2 N2 GND 1G
R3 N3 GND 1G
R4 N4 GND 1G
R5 N5 GND 1G

.control
* DC Operating Point Analysis
op
let bias_voltage_n0 = v(N0)
let power_consumption = -i(VVDD) * 1.8

print bias_voltage_n0
print power_consumption

* DC Sweep to observe VCTRL effect on N1
dc VVCTRL 0 1.8 0.1
print v(N1)

quit
.endc
.end
